import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'.')
import fuzz
from collections import Counter
stats = Counter()
bad = 0
for seed in range(150):
    campaign, gen, rng = fuzz.build_case(seed)
    campaign = fuzz.craft(campaign, gen, rng, rng.randint(3, 8))
    want = fuzz.expected(campaign, gen, rng)
    got = fuzz.kit.run_cli(json.loads(json.dumps(campaign, default=str)))
    if json.dumps(want, sort_keys=True) != json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True):
        bad += 1
        print("seed", seed, fuzz.diff(want, got))
    stats.update(r["status"] for r in want["records"])
    stats["machines"] += 1 if campaign["machine"] else 0
    stats["runs"] += len(want["records"])
print("bad", bad, dict(stats))
PYEOF
